title: Autofill postmortem sections from distributed trace signatures
creator: Marisol Reyes
description: Goal: Build an automated draft generator that extracts structured postmortem sections from correlated distributed traces, metric spikes, and log snippets, attaches the draft to PagerDuty incidents, and posts a reviewer-ready draft into the incident Slack thread. The feature should reduce time spent on creating postmortems for P1/P2 incidents by surfacing a pre-filled timeline, affected services, likely root-cause signatures, and suggested mitigation steps while providing a human-in-the-loop edit workflow. Scope includes: 1) tracing hook to mark and extract trace signatures tied to incident IDs, 2) enrichment pipeline to correlate metrics and logs with trace windows, 3) summarization extractor that outputs timeline/impact/root-cause/mitigation strings, 4) PD/Slack integration to attach drafts and start review threads, and 5) a Console drawer to review and publish postmortems to Confluence or GitHub. Success metrics: time-to-first-draft <= 15 minutes after incident creation, >40% reduction in manual drafting time for P1s, reviewer acceptance rate >= 85% (no major edits), and no PII leakage incidents in production. Constraints: sampled traces may miss critical spans, log retention windows vary across customers, and PD rate limits require backoff strategies.
comments: 2026-01-20 - Marisol Reyes: Initial scoping completed; spike planned for trace signature format and minimal summarizer prototype. Raised question about sensitive fields in spans (user ids) — flagged for security review.

2026-02-03 - Ethan Liu: Spike results: simple rule-based signature extractor can identify repeated span patterns and error codes across traces with 74% precision on historical incidents. Prototype repo created: github.com/redwood/obs/postmortem-draft-spike.

2026-02-18 - Priya Nair (SRE): Reviewed prototype, suggested adding metric anomaly correlator (prometheus histograms) and a conservative PII scrubber before attaching drafts to incidents. Also requested toggles per-customer for Private deployments.
2026-02-25 - Security: Security review kickoff. Requirements: KMS-backed scrub keys, redaction rules stored in Console, opt-out flag for customer-managed traces. Security review required: true.

2026-03-05 - Ethan Liu: Implemented PD attachment flow using PagerDuty incident notes API. Added exponential backoff for rate-limit handling. Drafts are now attached as 'Postmortem draft (auto)' with metadata: trace-signature-id and confidence score.
2026-03-10 - Design (Alex Kim): UX sketch for Console review drawer uploaded; includes accept/edit/publish and 'attach to incident' toggles. Link: drive.redwood.com/designs/postmortem-draft-v1.

2026-03-12 - QA (Nina Park): Running end-to-end tests against staging PD integration. Observed a race where trace ingestion lags incident creation for very short incidents (<2 minutes); plan to create a delayed re-run job to pick missing traces within first 15 minutes.
progress_notes: Spike complete: rule-based trace signature extractor (74% precision) and a heuristic summary builder implemented
PD attachment flow implemented and tested in sandbox
PII redaction prototype integrated with existing scrubber service; per-customer toggle added
Console review drawer design ready; front-end stubbed and linked to backend draft API
Open: metric/log correlator module (needs Prometheus/ELK queries), final acceptance tests, Canary rollout plan
acceptance_criteria: Automated draft created and attached to PD incident within 15 minutes for >=80% of historical P1 incidents in staging
Draft contains sections: timeline (with 1-3 timestamped events), affected services list, root-cause hypothesis, impact estimate (hosts/users), suggested mitigation steps
Console drawer allows reviewer to edit draft and publish to Confluence/GitHub or mark as 'no auto-draft'
PII redaction passes security tests and security review sign-off acquired
Canary rollout plan documented and rollback path defined
